meta.title: FestReady — a Steam capsule that reads, and a Next Fest wishlist forecast
meta.description: Build every Steam asset from your own art and see how many wishlists Next Fest can bring. Free capsule test at real sizes.

countdown.days: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} until registration closes: {fest}
countdown.closed: Registration for the next Next Fest is closed

home.titleLead: A capsule that reads at 120 px.
home.titleTail: A wishlist forecast before the Next Fest deadline.
home.subtitle: Build every Steam asset from your own art and see how many wishlists the festival can bring. Your files never leave your computer.

capsuleTest.title: Free capsule test
capsuleTest.lead: Drop your 462×174 small capsule — we'll show it at the sizes players see in search and wishlists and check it against Valve's rules.
capsuleTest.formats: PNG or JPG · the file never leaves your computer
capsuleTest.decodeError: Couldn't open the file. It needs to be a PNG or JPG image.
capsuleTest.ocrPending: Looking for text on the capsule…
capsuleTest.ocrFirstLoad: Loading text recognition for the first time — a few seconds
capsuleTest.ocrFailed: Couldn't check the text on the capsule. The other checks are ready.
capsuleTest.outlineHint: Draw a box around the title — with a mouse or a finger
capsuleTest.summaryOk: No errors found — the capsule is ready for Steamworks
capsuleTest.summaryOkAdvice: No errors found. Below are tips that will help the capsule in search

dimensions.title: Size
dimensions.legacy: {size} — the old small capsule size. Steamworks now expects exactly 462×174
dimensions.otherAsset: {size} — that's another Steam asset, not the small capsule. Showing how it would look cropped to 462×174
dimensions.wrongSize: {size} — the ratio is right, but Steamworks expects exactly 462×174
dimensions.wrongRatio: {size} — doesn't fit the 462×174 small capsule. Showing how it would look cropped

format.title: Format
format.unsupported: Steamworks only accepts PNG and JPG

weight.title: File size
weight.heavy: {mb, number} MB — over {max} MB. Save it as a JPG at 85–90% quality to avoid upload trouble

extraText.title: Extra text
extraText.ok: No review scores, awards, discounts or calls to action found
extraText.found: On the capsule: “{text}”. Valve bans review scores, awards, discounts and calls to action on capsules — this one will be rejected
extraText.override: On the capsule: “{text}”. Valve only allows text like this on a temporary Artwork Override (up to 14 days, localized into every language of the game). On the base capsule it will be rejected

logoWidth.title: Title size
logoWidth.ok: The title spans {percent}% of the width
logoWidth.narrow: The title spans {percent}% of the width. Steamworks recommends it nearly fill the small capsule — {min}% or more

contrast.title: Title contrast
contrast.ok: {ratio, number}:1 — the title stands out from the background
contrast.low: {ratio, number}:1 — below {min}:1. Darken the background behind the title or add an outline

readability.title: Legibility at 120×45
readability.ok: The title stays legible at the smallest size
readability.small: At 120×45 the title is {px} px tall — the letters blur together. Make it bigger
readability.blurry: At 120×45 the letters blend into the background: {ratio, number}:1 contrast
readability.thin: At 120×45 the strokes are thinner than a pixel — the letters fall apart. Use a bolder font
readability.notFound: We're not sure where the title is. Outline it to check its size, contrast and legibility

details.title: Fine detail
details.ok: The art doesn't turn into noise at small sizes
details.busy: Lots of fine detail: at 120×45 it turns into noise around the title
